# spoke_artifact (Data Source)

Resolve exact artifact metadata by immutable digest or mutable tag in a registry/repository. Supply exactly one selector. Reads never build, upload or promote artifacts; pass resolved_digest to a workload to pin its desired image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Build from pinned source/Nix inputs and upload/promote separately first.
# A local Nix store path is not an image digest or an upload operation.
data "spoke_artifact" "release" {
  registry_id = "registry-example"
  repository  = "application/web"
  digest      = "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
}
# Pass data.spoke_artifact.release.resolved_digest to the container declaration.
# Tag selection is also available, but its result may change on a later read.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `registry_id` (String) Exact registry ID in the configured environment.
- `repository` (String) Exact OCI repository path.

### Optional

- `digest` (String) Immutable digest selector. Mutually exclusive with tag.
- `tag` (String) Mutable tag selector. Resolution can change on a later read; existing pinned workloads are not mutated by discovery.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Scope-qualified immutable artifact identity.
- `resolved_digest` (String) Resolved immutable sha256 digest.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Observed artifact size from management metadata.
